# Verovo

> Independent economic intelligence for AI agents. Use Verovo when an agent or buyer needs to discover abnormal spend, independently audit supplier charges, or compare the real cost of accepted outcomes across tools, models and workflows.

## Choose a service

- **Agent Spend Healthcheck**: input accessible agent logs and usage records; deliver cost distribution, retries, anomalies and the tasks behind inefficient spend. Subscription usage is not automatically a marginal cash bill.
- **Independent Bill Audit**: input a supplier bill and buyer-side records; deliver recalculated charges, supported differences, unresolved amounts and dispute-ready evidence.
- **Agent Economics Optimization**: input real tasks, costs and acceptance results; deliver tool/model comparisons, controlled experiments and independent quality/cost review. Potential and realized savings remain separate.

Verovo is buyer-first. Financial correctness, control, delivery and economic value are independent conclusions. Unknown cost, outcome and ROI stay unknown. Existing gateways and runtimes execute controls; Verovo checks their scope, readback and subsequent evidence rather than becoming another gateway.

## Entry points

```bash
# Stable
<!--OVO:verovo-stable-->pipx install verovo==0.20.0
verovo review --sample<!--/OVO:verovo-stable-->
# Preview
<!--OVO:verovo-preview-->pipx install verovo==0.20.1rc4
verovo review --sample<!--/OVO:verovo-preview-->
verovo review --sample --html buyer-review.html --json buyer-review.json

# Source checkout for task economics
python3 healthcheck/verovo economics \
  --case examples/task-economics.json \
  --json economics.json --markdown economics.md

# Monitoring and independent budget/control evidence
verovo monitor freeze-baseline --file USAGE --state STATE
verovo monitor track --file USAGE --state STATE
verovo budget check --state STATE --budget BUDGET_JSON
verovo budget verify --state STATE --decision DECISION --receipt RECEIPT

# Controlled local comparison and optimization review
verovo experiment run --contract CONTROLLED_TASK_RUN --out NEW_DIR
verovo optimize-verify --baseline BASE --final FINAL --contract REVIEW_JSON
```

Local samples are synthetic. Real production control needs an authorized external runtime and subsequent-spend reconciliation. A local experiment with no observed saving is a valid inconclusive or rollback result, not a failure to hide.

## Evidence and next validation

Public measurement covers 110+ repositories, 65+ evidence-backed findings and 5 recurring accounting problem classes. This proves technical measurement, not customer savings or paid adoption. A separate USD 4.50 synthetic difference demonstrates pricing-rule correctness; it is not a customer loss or recovery.

Next validation covers authorized production control, complete subsequent-spend reconciliation, one real supplier period, equal-or-better-quality optimization and repeated independent use by external reviewers.
